text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Rifampin interacts with oral anticoagulants such as warfarin, leading to a decrease in their exposure and potentially reducing their therapeutic effectiveness [rifampin:drug_interactions:6]. Because of this decreased exposure, the label recommends performing prothrombin time daily or as frequently as necessary to establish and maintain the required dose of the anticoagulant [rifampin:drug_interactions:6].
